policy.causal_rule: Descriptive sentiment is not a price forecast. Feature-quality defects must be tested for their effect on out-of-sample performance; a proposed code change is not a deployed fix.

nodes.label: Draft PR #1324 emitter and data-quality guard

edges.claim: At main 750ccb, scripts/emit_signal.py can fall back to score 50/confidence 0.5 for malformed model JSON; when providers fail it returns zero confidence but still blends with news_score. The output has no forecast_status, target, horizon or calibrated return probability. PR #1324 proposes strict schema validation and explicit NOT_ISSUED metadata; the proposal is not merged.

The current news score loop ignored timestamp parse failures and did not reject non-finite relevance weights; this can admit stale or malformed rows into a time-windowed feature. PR #1324 proposes excluding missing/malformed/timezone-naive timestamps, non-finite/nonpositive weights and unknown sentiment labels.

hypotheses.statement: Asset-scoped, timestamp-valid news sentiment may add incremental short-horizon information beyond price/volume baselines, but current headline score alone does not establish predictive value.
disconfirming_evidence: News may be noisy, duplicated, stale, already priced in, or weakly related to XRP returns; model-generated labels can reflect source selection bias.
tests_needed: Build immutable timestamped features; deduplicate by stable event/source identity; compare price/volume baseline versus baseline-plus-news using walk-forward splits, leakage checks, calibration, and ablation. Keep a separate holdout and log all rejected records.

hypotheses.statement: Fail-open timestamp parsing may admit stale records into a rolling 72-hour news feature and create leakage or distort its effective window.
disconfirming_evidence: If the underlying log has few malformed or naive timestamps, empirical impact may be small; the size of the affected population is not yet measured.
tests_needed: Profile timestamp parse failures and timezone-naive records by source/date, preserve rejected-row counts and provenance, then compare pre/post feature distributions and walk-forward performance without changing historical records.

notes: PR #1324 is draft and unmerged. Its CI and gate were not visible at the 13:10Z cutoff.
Even a successful sentiment classifier remains a descriptive signal, not a price forecast, until a calibrated fixed-horizon model is separately implemented and evaluated.
No XRP market feature was admitted and no forecast was issued.
